body:
# Raise Sound Limit Simplified (Unofficial Forge Port)

An Unofficial Port for [Raise Sound Limit Simplified](https://modrinth.com/mod/rsls), a mod that raises Minecraft sound sources limit in a simple way.

# Configuration

The configuration file is located at `.minecraft/config/rsls.properties`.

An in-game editor is available if cloth config is installed

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e62cfc844b714e225e0cc92371af88fb4bc0657.png)

# License

Like [Raise Sound Limit Simplified](https://modrinth.com/mod/rsls), this mod is open-source under the **MIT License**.

You may include it in your modpacks/servers as long as you **comply with the license terms**.
